simplesect.para: size of the array struct with a buffer of capacity cap.

briefdescription.para: Tries to push a value to the bottom.
Tries to pop a value from the bottom.

parameterdescription.para: output parameter address of popped object.

simplesect.para: VDEQUE_STATE_EMPTY if deque is empty, or if it failed to take the last element.

briefdescription.para: Tries to (steal) pop a value from the top.

parameterdescription.para: output parameter address of popped object.

simplesect.para: VDEQUE_STATE_ABORT if failed to pop because of contention.

detaileddescription.para: The deque has a bounded size and returns errors in case the deque is full, empty, or if there is contention while trying to pop/steal.
David Chase, Yossi Lev - [Dynamic Circular Work-Stealing Deque] (https://dl.acm.org/doi/pdf/10.1145/1073970.1073974)
